reason: Our brand looks dated and we are growing into a bigger market this year, so I need to look at a rebrand anyway. A free first look costs me nothing and a comment is a quick way to see whether their work is any good.
objection: I am not sure a remote studio understands my market or can be there when I need changes. Local agencies at least sit in the same time zone and can meet in person, and a free look could just be a sales pitch.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few finished identities for businesses like mine, such as a hotel or clinic, with a named client I can contact about how the work went and how they handled revisions.
